note: One case per tool, each written at the boundary the routing table names: the expected tool, and the neighbour a reader could mistake for it. The structural half of the suite checks coverage against src/routing.ts; the scored half is run by hand with --print-prompt or --decisions.

cases.prompt: Does this order state machine have a reachable state where it is paid but never shipped?
cases.why: one machine on its own, not a composition

cases.prompt: Two workers both increment the same counter through one queue. Can an update be lost?
cases.why: two machines and a shared location

cases.prompt: Does our parser accept every message the specification's grammar accepts?
cases.why: a language relation, not reachability in one machine

cases.prompt: Rename the state idle to waiting and add a transition from waiting to done on commit.
cases.why: an edit round, answered with the diff

cases.prompt: Our migration dropped a column. Did any row lose a value that the old table held?
cases.why: stored data across a migration, not behaviour over time

cases.prompt: Does this design keep its own layering rule, and can the subtype stand in for the supertype?
cases.why: the design's own declarations, not a graph audit

cases.prompt: The plan says the scheduler is thread-safe. Which claims does it make, and who decides them?
cases.why: mining claims and routing them, before any protocol is built

cases.prompt: Turn this model into a TLA+ spec so we can check the liveness property ourselves.
cases.why: a translation for a property this plugin does not decide

cases.prompt: What changed between the report we had last week and the one we just ran?
cases.why: two reports to compare, not a new run

cases.prompt: Draw this state machine as a PlantUML state diagram.
Read this Mermaid stateDiagram back into a model we can run.
cases.why: reading a diagram, not auditing it

cases.prompt: Is this diagram's modelling sound - unreachable states, ambiguous branches, a dead end?
What labels will the PlantUML parser accept for a deployment diagram?
cases.why: the accepted spellings, not a particular diagram

cases.prompt: Scan the source tree for import cycles between these packages.
cases.why: a graph, from the code rather than from a drawing
